```{r}
metdiffpath = "../results/metabolomics/DifferentialAnalysis/TtestMetabolomic.xlsx"

metAll = mtbDt

for (var in variables){
  
cmps = c()
tpval = c()
nTot = c()
nNom = c()
meanNom = c()
stNom = c()
nDen = c()
meanDen = c()
stDen = c()
logFc = c()
nom = "1"
den = "0"
meTmp = metAll[metAll[,var] %in% c(nom, den),]
for (cmp in colnames(metAll)) {
  if (!cmp %in% variables) {
    
 test_result <- NULL
tryCatch({
  test_result <- wilcox.test(meTmp[,cmp] ~ meTmp[,var], meTmp)
}, error = function(e) {
  cat("Error in processing column", cmp, ": ", e$message, "\n")
})
if (!is.null(test_result)) {
  tpval = append(tpval, test_result$p.value)
} else {
  tpval = append(tpval, NA)  # Se c'è un errore, metti NA
}
    
    cmps = append(cmps, cmp)
    #tpval = append(tpval, test_result$p.value)
    nTot = append(nTot, nrow(meTmp))
    nomTmp = meTmp[meTmp[,var] == nom,]
    nNom = append(nNom, nrow(nomTmp))
    meanNom = append(meanNom, mean(nomTmp[,cmp]))
    stNom = append(stNom, sd(nomTmp[,cmp]))
    
    
    denTmp = meTmp[meTmp[,var] == den,]
    nDen = append(nDen, nrow(denTmp))
    meanDen = append(meanDen, mean(denTmp[,cmp]))
    stDen = append(stDen, sd(denTmp[,cmp]))
    lfc = (mean(nomTmp[,cmp]) - mean(denTmp[,cmp]))
    logFc = append(logFc, lfc  )
    
  }

}
  fdr = p.adjust((tpval), method = "fdr")
logFct = log2(abs(logFc))
logFc = (logFc)
res = NA
res = cbind(cmps,nTot, nNom,meanNom, stNom, nDen, meanDen, stDen,logFc, tpval, fdr)
res = as.data.frame(res)
colnames(res) = c("cmps", "n",paste0("n_",nom), paste0("mean_",nom), paste0("StDev_",nom), paste0("n_",den), paste0("mean_",den), paste0("StDev",den), "logFc", "p-value", "fdr")

res = res[(res$"p-value") != NaN,]
res = res[order(res$"p-value"),]

}
```

Funzione rcorr con pvalue corretti
```{r}
library(Hmisc)

p_adjust_method = "fdr"

rcorr.adjust <- function (x, type = c("pearson", "spearman"), 
            use = c("complete.obs", "pairwise.complete.obs")) {
    opt <- options(scipen = 5)
    on.exit(options(opt))
    type <- match.arg(type)
    use <- match.arg(use)
    x <- if (use == "complete.obs") 
      as.matrix(na.omit(x))
    else as.matrix(x)
    R <- rcorr(x, type = type)
    P <- P.unadj <- R$P
    p <- P[lower.tri(P)]
    adj.p <- p.adjust(p, method = p_adjust_method)
    P[lower.tri(P)] <- adj.p
    P[upper.tri(P)] <- 0
    P <- P + t(P)
    P <- ifelse(P < 1e-04, 0, P)
    P <- format(round(P, 4))
    diag(P) <- ""
    P[c(grep("0.0000", P), grep("^ 0$", P))] <- "<.0001"
    P[grep("0.000$", P)] <- "<.001"
    P.unadj <- ifelse(P.unadj < 1e-04, 0, P.unadj)
    P.unadj <- format(round(P.unadj, 4))
    diag(P.unadj) <- ""
    P.unadj[c(grep("0.0000$", P.unadj), grep("^ 0$", P.unadj))] <- "<.0001"
    P.unadj[grep("0.000$", P.unadj)] <- "<.001"
    result <- list(R = R, P = P, P.unadj = P.unadj, type = type)
    class(result) <- "rcorr.adjust"
    result
  }

print.rcorr.adjust <- function(x, ...){
    cat("\n", if (x$type == "pearson") "Pearson" else "Spearman", "correlations:\n")
    print(round(x$R$r, 4))
    cat("\n Number of observations: ")
    n <- x$R$n
    if (all(n[1] == n)) cat(n[1], "\n")
    else{
        cat("\n")
        print(n)
    }
    cat("\n Pairwise two-sided p-values:\n")
    print(x$P.unadj, quote=FALSE)
    cat("\n Adjusted p-values (Holm's method)\n")
    print(x$P, quote=FALSE)
}
```

```{r}
# Prerequisiti
library(igraph)
library(dplyr)
library(scales)
library(tibble)

# Le tue matrici
R <- as.matrix(logFC_df)   # correlazioni
P <- as.matrix(pvalue_df)  # p-values

stopifnot(all(dim(R) == dim(P)))  # devono avere stesse dimensioni

# Parametri
alpha <- 0.05
use_p_adjust <- FALSE
metodo <- "BH"

# (Opzionale) correzione multipla
useP <- P
if (use_p_adjust) {
  p_all <- as.vector(P)
  p_all_adj <- p.adjust(p_all, method = metodo)
  useP <- matrix(p_all_adj, nrow = nrow(P), ncol = ncol(P),
                 dimnames = dimnames(P))
}

# Forza NA sulla diagonale solo se quadrata (per evitare auto-archi)
if (nrow(R) == ncol(R)) {
  diag(R) <- 1
  diag(useP) <- NA_real_
}

is_square <- nrow(R) == ncol(R) &&
             !is.null(rownames(R)) && !is.null(colnames(R)) &&
             all(rownames(R) %in% colnames(R)) && all(colnames(R) %in% rownames(R))

if (is_square) {
  # Caso matrice quadrata: prendo solo il triangolo superiore (niente duplicati)
  mask <- upper.tri(R)
  edges <- tibble(
    i = rownames(R)[row(R)[mask]],
    j = colnames(R)[col(R)[mask]],
    r = R[mask],
    p = useP[mask]
  ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(p), p < alpha)
} else {
  # Caso rettangolare (bipartito): tengo tutte le coppie riga-colonna
  edges <- tibble(
    i = rep(rownames(R), times = ncol(R)),
    j = rep(colnames(R), each = nrow(R)),
    r = as.vector(R),
    p = as.vector(useP)
  ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(p), p < alpha)
}

message(sprintf("Archi mantenuti (p < %.2f): %d", alpha, nrow(edges)))

# Crea il grafo
g <- graph_from_data_frame(
  d = edges %>%
    transmute(from = i, to = j,
              weight = abs(r),
              sign   = ifelse(r >= 0, "pos", "neg"),
              r = r, p = p),
  directed = FALSE
)

# Se bipartito, puoi (opzionale) marcare i due tipi di nodo
if (!is_square) {
  V(g)$type <- V(g)$name %in% rownames(R)  # TRUE = gruppo righe, FALSE = gruppo colonne
}

# Stile archi: blu (+) / rosso (−), spessore ∝ |r|
E(g)$color <- ifelse(E(g)$sign == "pos", "#2b8cbe", "#de2d26")
E(g)$width <- rescale(E(g)$weight, to = c(1, 6))

# Nodi (facoltativo): dimensione ∝ strength
V(g)$size <- 10 + 2 * log1p(strength(g, weights = E(g)$weight))
V(g)$label.cex <- 0.9

## --- classi, forme, bordo e (opzionale) riempimento ---
row_set <- rownames(R); col_set <- colnames(R)

V(g)$tipo  <- ifelse(V(g)$name %in% row_set, "Metabolita",
                     ifelse(V(g)$name %in% col_set, "Taxon", "Altro"))

V(g)$shape <- ifelse(V(g)$tipo == "Metabolita", "circle",
                     ifelse(V(g)$tipo == "Taxon", "square", "circle"))

## <<< CAMBIO 1: bordo nero spesso >>>
V(g)$frame.color <- "black"
V(g)$frame.width <- 2.2
## === COLORI DEFINITI ===
col_taxa <- "#DAA520"   # blu
col_metaboliti<- "#66C2A5"   # giallo-oro
#66C2A5
V(g)$color <- ifelse(V(g)$tipo == "Metabolita", col_metaboliti, col_taxa)


# Layout
set.seed(123)
## --- make it breathe: layout, alpha, curve, label offset ---

# 1) Layout FR più stabile e pesato (archi forti tengono insieme i cluster)
set.seed(123)
lay <- layout_with_fr(g, weights = E(g)$weight, niter = 4000, grid = "nogrid")
lay <- lay * 1.6
#l <- layout.fruchterman.reingold(g, niter=5000, area=vcount(g)^4*10)
# 2) Archi semi-trasparenti e leggermente curvi
E(g)$col_base <- ifelse(E(g)$sign == "pos", "#2b8cbe", "#de2d26")
E(g)$color    <- adjustcolor(E(g)$col_base, alpha.f = 0.6)  # trasparenza
E(g)$width    <- scales::rescale(E(g)$weight, to = c(0.5, 4))
edge_curve    <- 0.15

# 3) Nodi un filo più piccoli (e meno differenze)
V(g)$size <- 6 + 1.5 * log1p(strength(g, weights = E(g)$weight))

# 4) Etichette spinte verso l’esterno del centro del grafico
cx <- mean(lay[,1]); cy <- mean(lay[,2])
theta <- atan2(lay[,2] - cy, lay[,1] - cx)
V(g)$label.cex <- 1.6   # prova 1.3–2.2 a seconda del gusto
V(g)$label.degree <- theta
V(g)$label.dist   <- 0.6

# 5) Plot

svg("../results/crossOmics/CorrNetworkF2.svg", width = 30, height = 20)

par(cex = 1.4)   # <-- Fix testuale

V(g)$label.cex <- 1.4  # <-- Fix etichette nodo

plot(g, layout = lay,
     vertex.shape       = V(g)$shape,
     vertex.color       = V(g)$color,
     vertex.frame.color = V(g)$frame.color,
     vertex.frame.width = V(g)$frame.width %||% 1.2,
     vertex.label.color = "black",
     edge.curved        = edge_curve,
     main = sprintf("Correlation Network (p < %.2f)", alpha))

dev.off()



# legende archi (come prima)
legend("topleft",
       legend = c("r > 0", "r < 0"),
       lwd = 3, col = c("#2b8cbe", "#de2d26"), bty = "n")

# legende nodi (bordo = col, riempimento = pt.bg)
legend("left",
       legend = c("Metaboliti", "Taxa"),
       pch = c(21, 22),
       col = "black",                       # bordo nero
       pt.bg = c(col_metaboliti, col_taxa), # riempimento
       pt.cex = 1.5, bty = "n")


```

```{r}
## --- make it breathe: layout, alpha, curve, label offset ---

# 1) Layout FR più stabile e pesato (archi forti tengono insieme i cluster)
set.seed(123)
lay <- layout_with_fr(g, weights = E(g)$weight, niter = 4000, grid = "nogrid")

# 2) Archi semi-trasparenti e leggermente curvi
E(g)$col_base <- ifelse(E(g)$sign == "pos", "#2b8cbe", "#de2d26")
E(g)$color    <- adjustcolor(E(g)$col_base, alpha.f = 0.6)  # trasparenza
E(g)$width    <- scales::rescale(E(g)$weight, to = c(0.5, 4))
edge_curve    <- 0.15

# 3) Nodi un filo più piccoli (e meno differenze)
V(g)$size <- 6 + 1.5 * log1p(strength(g, weights = E(g)$weight))

# 4) Etichette spinte verso l’esterno del centro del grafico
cx <- mean(lay[,1]); cy <- mean(lay[,2])
theta <- atan2(lay[,2] - cy, lay[,1] - cx)
V(g)$label.cex    <- 0.75
V(g)$label.degree <- theta
V(g)$label.dist   <- 0.6

# 5) Plot
plot(g, layout = lay,
     vertex.shape       = V(g)$shape,
     vertex.color       = V(g)$color,        # se l’avevi impostato (fill)
     vertex.frame.color = V(g)$frame.color,
     vertex.frame.width = V(g)$frame.width %||% 1.2,
     vertex.label.color = "black",
     edge.curved        = edge_curve,
     main = sprintf("Correlation Network (p < %.2f)", alpha))
```

```{r}
  cluster_columns = T,
  rect_gp = gpar(col = "black", lwd = 1),
   row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12), column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10))



png(Heatmp, width = 50/2.54, height = 40/2.54, res = 200, units = "in")
draw(htmp, heatmap_legend_side = "right", padding = unit(c(2, 2, 2, 8), "cm"))
dev.off()

```
